profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I graduated from U.C. Berkeley in December 2016 studying Computer Science. I am passionate about developing extensible and iteratively enhanced software, and breaking down complexity that comes from maintaining largely segmented repositories. 

Breaking things to find bugs and discovering unintended 'features' for documentation are my inspiration to improve with best practices in development and utilizing smarter designs and algorithms.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed point to point encrypted payment solutions, servicing high transaction throughput

Maintained and refactored codebase to incorporate microarchitecture design and reduce code size

Developed monitoring pipelines to observe and analyze a wide range of data sources for fraudulent activity

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed a payment orchestration platform connecting various eCommerce frameworks to mediate with various processors
Created REST APIs, UI/UX components, and business processing to integrate with those various processors

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
· Developed Razor webpages with Asp.Net using C# and Microsoft SQL for an electricity market platform
· Developed database schema and stored procedures for the document management system and customer relational management system
· Maintained front-end grids using AngularJS including debugging, testing and development
· Handled requirement discovery on business goals for feature development

positions.title: Junior Android SDK Engineer
positions.description:
• Maintained a software development kit for the Android Operating System in order to deliver advertisements, including static and video media.

• Managed connections to partner advertisement companies in order to mediate advertisement content for our publishers.

• Worked with a variety of technologies including Java, Javascript, and HTML.

volunteerExperiences.description: Mentoring children from kindergarten to 5th grade in academic and social activities, including one-on-one tutoring, reading, and supervising during outdoors activities.
Assisted in directing patients and visitors to their desired locations, and helped with transporting lab samples and results.
